title: The Rain, 2024
logline: The twenty-seventh January: the sill, the four jars, the rain, and the pup at nine in the bed. A week before the bird joins the sill. The page as the strip would have drawn it, minus the tiers.

panels.composition: The casement window in January rain from inside, four jars on the sill, the gray light, a small three-legged dog asleep in a bed below, the lamp off.
